SELECT
  LEFT(CAST(oi.order_item_id AS TEXT), 10) AS order_item_id,
  LEFT(CAST(oi.order_id AS TEXT), 10) AS order_id,
  LEFT(CAST(oi.product_id AS TEXT), 10) AS product_id,
  LEFT(CAST(oi.seller_id AS TEXT), 10) AS seller_id,
  CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS purchase_date,
  ABS(SUM(COALESCE(oi.freight_value, 0))) AS freight_value
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY
  LEFT(CAST(oi.order_item_id AS TEXT), 10),
  LEFT(CAST(oi.order_id AS TEXT), 10),
  LEFT(CAST(oi.product_id AS TEXT), 10),
  LEFT(CAST(oi.seller_id AS TEXT), 10),
  CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
ORDER BY
  CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE),
  LEFT(CAST(oi.order_id AS TEXT), 10),
  LEFT(CAST(oi.order_item_id AS TEXT), 10);
